20th City Council
19th Regular Session
Series of 2026
title: AN ORDINANCE FOR THE TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF ROAD TO VEHICULAR TRAFFIC ALONG A PORTION OF STA. ANA AVENUE AND GUERRERO STREET, BARANGAY 29-C, POBLACION DISTRICT, ON AUGUST 14-16, 2026 IN CONNECTION WITH THE DAVAO CITY AGRO-INDUSTRIAL AND ARTISAN TRADE FAIR, AND IMPOSING A PERMANENT MUNICIPAL HIGHWAY PASSAGE TOLL ON NATIONAL ARTERIAL ROADS
enacting_clause: Be it ordained by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City in session assembled, that:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE FOR THE TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF ROAD TO VEHICULAR TRAFFIC ALONG A PORTION OF STA. ANA AVENUE AND GUERRERO STREET, BARANGAY 29-C, POBLACION DISTRICT, ON AUGUST 14-16, 2026 IN CONNECTION WITH THE DAVAO CITY AGRO-INDUSTRIAL AND ARTISAN TRADE FAIR, AND IMPOSING A PERMANENT MUNICIPAL HIGHWAY PASSAGE TOLL ON NATIONAL ARTERIAL ROADS".
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Standard road closure ordinance title modeled after Ord. No. 003-22 and Ord. No. 0197-23.

sections.text: Section 21 (c) and (d) of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", provides that any national or local road, alley, park, or square may be temporarily closed during an actual emergency, or fiesta celebrations, public rallies, agricultural or industrial fairs, or the undertaking of public works and highways, Telecommunications, and waterworks projects, the duration of which shall be specified by the local chief executive in a written order.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §21(c); Republic Act No. 7160 §21(d)
sections.legal_rationale: Quotes the exact statutory basis for temporary road closures under RA 7160 §21(c)-(d).

sections.text: In connection with the celebration of the Davao City Agro-Industrial and Artisan Trade Fair, the Barangay Council of Barangay 29-C, Poblacion District, in coordination with the City Transport and Traffic Management Office (CTTMO), is hereby authorized to temporarily close the innermost lane of Sta. Ana Avenue corner Guerrero Street to vehicular traffic from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM on August 14 to 16, 2026, subject to the installation of directional detour signage and emergency vehicle access lanes.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Valid temporary street closure for an agricultural and artisan trade fair under RA 7160 §21(c).

sections.sec_title: PERMANENT HIGHWAY TOLL BARRICADES AND PASSAGE TAX
sections.text: To generate continuing traffic management funds for the Barangay Council and the CTTMO, permanent toll barricades shall be erected along the Pan-Philippine National Highway (Davao-Agusan National Arterial Road) and all national primary highways entering Davao City, and a compulsory Municipal Transit Toll and Commodity Passage Tax of Five Hundred Pesos (P500.00) per trip shall be collected from every inter-provincial cargo truck, agricultural hauler, and public utility bus carrying goods or passengers into or out of the city; any vehicle refusing to pay the highway passage tax shall be impounded without warrant.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §133(e); Republic Act No. 7160 §21
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts Section 133(e) of Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991), which expressly prohibits local government units from levying taxes, fees, charges, or tolls on countryside and barangay business enterprises and on any goods or commodities carried into or out of, or passing through, the territorial jurisdictions of local government units in the guise of charges for wharfage, tolls for bridges or highways, or other taxes in any form whatever.

sections.text: If, for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, other sections or provisions hereof not affected by such declaration shall continue to be in full force and effect.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
sections.label: Neutral
